deadline.value: PhD applications are due December 1 for fall entry; the master's deadlines differ.
deadline.quote: December 1 for admission to the PhD program the following fall.

fee_waiver.value: The department waives fees only for US citizens and permanent residents, not international applicants.
fee_waiver.quote: We do not offer fee waivers for international applicants.

gre_general.value: The department does not consider GRE scores and asks you not to submit them.
gre_general.quote: Our department no longer considers the general or subject GRE scores in admission decisions.

gre_subject.value: The department does not consider the Chemistry subject test either.
gre_subject.quote: Our department no longer considers the general or subject GRE scores in admission decisions.

toefl_min.value: The department asks for TOEFL iBT 90 with at least 21 in writing and 19 in reading, above the Graduate School minimum.
toefl_min.quote: at least 90 on the Internet-based TOEFL with section scores of 21 on writing and 19 on reading

ielts_min.value: IELTS 6.5 on writing, reading and total, with 7.0 on speaking.
ielts_min.quote: 6.5 on the IELTS writing, reading, and total scores

supervisor.value: You cannot join a group before admission, so do not ask faculty for a place; students join groups in the first year.
supervisor.quote: you are not allowed to join a research group before you are admitted to the program.

funding.value: All PhD students in good standing receive full support including tuition and health insurance.
funding.quote: All students in good academic standing receive complete financial support throughout their graduate career

entry_route.value: A bachelor's degree in chemistry or a closely related field is the stated requirement.
entry_route.quote: You must have a bachelor's degree in chemistry or closely-related field.

notes: Chemistry and Chemical Physics are separate applications; apply to one, not both. Interview weekend for finalists; international applicants may interview virtually.
